Periodic shells have no overlap (minimum distance 2.530 A), coherent complete coordination, full stoichiometry, and a charge-neutral Ce3+/Pt0/N3- assignment; no chemistry veto or concrete surviving framework, symmetry, occupancy, superstructure, or ordering branch is supported.
